Kids 24+ months require a ticket; toddlers 23 months and under may sit on a parent's lap for free.
Each passenger MUST bring a valid photo ID.
A digital waiver must be signed by each passenger during check-in.
The credit card used for this booking and a matching photo ID of the cardholder must be presented for verification upon check-in.
Both cards MUST be present physically or digitally to proceed with the flight.
Minors must be accompanied by a parent or adult.
Sarasota Romantic Helicopter Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.

meetingPoint: All Tampa helicopter tours depart from Peter O. Knight Airport (TPF), Davis Islands, Tampa. Free on-site parking available.

Standard Cancellations and Changes A minimum of 24 hours written notice (via email to info@flyventure.com) is required for any cancellation or change to your reservation.
policies: Instant confirmation and no hidden fees.
Cancellations or changes made within 24 hours of your scheduled flight are non-refundable and will be charged in full.
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance will not receive a cash refund.
